deviation: The draft moves governing law and exclusive jurisdiction from New York (New York County) to Delaware. Delaware may count as neutral law, but the fallback needs Legal approval, and that approval isn't shown. Without it, Arcadia would have to litigate outside its preferred forum.
suggested_text: 13.1 Governing Law and Jurisdiction. This Agreement and any dispute arising out of or in connection with it shall be governed by the laws of the State of New York. The courts located in New York County, New York have exclusive jurisdiction.
